# Deterministic regression fixtures

These files isolate browser-cleaning behavior. They are synthetic observations,
not product demonstrations or acquired institutional data.

The research catalogue retains multiple facility records, organization context,
Unicode, ranges, nested instrument tables and website links. It includes a record
without an explicit country, an organization-level aside and removable navigation,
scripts and cookie controls. The expected semantic tree checks that cleaning removes
presentation noise without discarding the main source structure.

Large-input, recovery, source-policy and format tests construct their data in temporary
directories. Gigabyte fixtures do not belong in the source tree. Reproduce large
workloads using the observation example or streaming benchmark scripts.
